name: 한 획의 나기
quote: 단 한 번의 궤적이 운명을 가른다.
silhouette: 거대한 붓을 옆으로 든 웅크린 맹수, 길게 뻗은 꼬리, 흩날리는 붉은색 매듭 장식
signature_vfx: 바닥에 새겨지는 붉은색 붓글씨 문양과 황금빛 폭발
visual_en: A majestic white tiger-like divine beast facing right, featuring a large glowing amber eye. It wears lavish royal gold armor plates over its pure white fur. A thick crimson red silk ornament flows from its neck, acting as a cape. The beast holds a massive, heavy calligraphy brush with ink-black bristles tipped with glowing amber light. Its enormous, thick tail is decorated with small golden bells and red tassels. A radiant golden aura surrounds its entire body, with black ink particles floating around the brush tip.
pose_en: Crouching low in a predatory stance, ready to pounce forward.
vfx_en: Glowing crimson calligraphy strokes appearing on the ground with golden sparks.
motion_en: A sudden, high-speed dash leaving a trail of red ink.
lore: 던전 스테이지 보스. 붉게 웅크렸다가 돌진, 탄막, 플레이어 발밑에 예고 장판, 졸개 소환을 한다.
